sources.content: AGENTS.md for dunmarrow. Dunmarrow is a Rust library for parsing and building DNS messages. The minimum supported Rust version is 1.75. Run `cargo test --all-features` before every commit; CI runs the same command on Linux and macOS. Parser code lives in `src/wire/`, and the record types live in `src/rdata/`, one file per type. Never add a dependency without opening an issue first. Fuzz targets live in `fuzz/` and run with `cargo fuzz run parse_message`.

Public API changes need an entry in `CHANGELOG.md` under the Unreleased heading. Do not use unsafe code anywhere; the crate sets `forbid(unsafe_code)` in `src/lib.rs`. Name compression must stay off by default when building messages. Test fixtures are captured packets in `tests/fixtures/`, stored as `.bin` files, and each new fixture needs a matching `.txt` file that describes the packet. Format with `cargo fmt` and keep clippy clean with `-D warnings`. Only maintainers cut releases.
